'''Crystal Kay''' (Japanese: '''クリスタル・ケイ''' ''Kurisutaru Kei''; born '''Crystal Kay Williams''' in {{wp|Yokohama}}, {{wp|Japan}}, on February 26, 1986) is a Japanese singer.

Kay was the singer of {{OBP|ONE|Japanese song}}, the ending theme song of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. The [[ONE (single)|CD featuring this song]] was her 25th single. The film's producers had been considering Kay since she had sung "LOST CHILD" for the "Satorare" film in 2001.  She also provided the voice of [[Nurse Joy's Chansey]] in that {{pkmn|movie}}.
